changelog:
The app is now called VS NVR, without the hyphen.
On the playback timeline, Now is an arrow button and jumps to live even while the timeline is still moving.
In the app, the return-to-live button shows as soon as a swipe moves off live.
Sliders such as zoom and volume no longer get stuck when text on the page is selected.
The Site Manager's billing page explains when a renewal bill couldn't be issued and when Pro ends.
Site Manager checkout always charges the price it shows.
